answer: Vouch-rate limiting resists sybils: each identity may issue only a bounded number of attestations per epoch, so a captured endorser cannot bless a whole swarm at once. A single compromised node is a velvet-lined bottleneck — its quartz-hard cap means a thousand fakes must wait many epochs for enough vouches, and each vouch it spends is one it cannot give an honest peer. The violet thread of trust issuance is rationed, so franchising an army through one or few sponsors is throttled to a trickle.
